location: California and Mediterranean (Italy, USA, Spain, France, Greece)
comparison: winter legume cover crop vs. winter fallow / bare soil
quote: Compared to plots without cover crops, food crop yield was 16% higher (R = 1.16) in plots with cover crops that were legumes.
note: All food crops pooled (12 crops; maize in 21 publications, also tomato, pepper, lettuce); not corn- or soybean-specific. Overall yield analysis: 38 publications, 123 experiments, 316 comparisons (Table 2); legume-subset n and CI only in Fig. 3. Mostly irrigated and fertilized in both treatments. Overall pooled effect (all cover crops) was not significant, with the value shown only in Fig. 2.
